Community `v3.1.2` adds the production website management console and deployment polish.

## Included

- Added an authenticated Cloud Waste Scanner admin console at `/admin/`.
- Added session-backed dashboard views for traffic, funnel, and governance data.
- Added friendly 403 and 404 handling for the static site.
- Added deployment documentation and environment defaults for the admin backend.
- Preserved isolated Nginx routing for existing domains.
